Interface NettyZlibCodecFactory

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultNettyZlibCodecFactory
public interface NettyZlibCodecFactory
Creates compression handlers for HTTP connections, streams, and WebSocket extensions. Calls may arrive concurrently from different event loops. Each call must return a fresh handler whose resources are released when it is removed, except for sharable WebSocket handlers. A replacement bean applies independently of the configured channel transport.
Since:
5.3.0

    • newZlibEncoder

      io.netty.handler.codec.compression.ZlibEncoder newZlibEncoder(io.netty.handler.codec.compression.ZlibWrapper wrapper, int compressionLevel, int windowBits, int memLevel)
      Creates an encoder. ZlibWrapper.ZLIB_OR_NONE is not valid for encoding.
      Parameters:
      wrapper - The wrapper format
      compressionLevel - The compression level, from 0 to 9
      windowBits - The window size, from 9 to 15
      memLevel - The memory level, from 1 to 9
      Returns:
      A fresh encoder
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • compressZlib

      default @Nullable io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf compressZlib(io.netty.handler.codec.compression.ZlibWrapper wrapper, int compressionLevel, int windowBits, int memLevel, io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf body, io.netty.buffer.ByteBufAllocator allocator)
      Compresses a complete body into one zlib or gzip stream, in place of an encoder from newZlibEncoder(ZlibWrapper, int, int, int) when the caller already has the whole body. The result must decode to the body, but need not match the encoder's bytes. The default returns null, so the caller streams the body through an encoder.
      Parameters:
      wrapper - The wrapper format, ZlibWrapper.GZIP or ZlibWrapper.ZLIB
      compressionLevel - The compression level, from 0 to 9
      windowBits - The window size, from 9 to 15
      memLevel - The memory level, from 1 to 9
      body - The complete body, still owned by the caller
      allocator - The allocator for the result
      Returns:
      The compressed stream, owned by the caller, or null to use an encoder
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • newWebSocketServerCompressionHandler

      default io.netty.handler.codec.http.websocketx.extensions.WebSocketServerExtensionHandler newWebSocketServerCompressionHandler(int maxMessageBytes)
      Creates a server handler that negotiates WebSocket compression extensions. The default retains Netty's compression settings and allocation policy. Overrides may enforce the endpoint's payload limit on decompressed messages.
      Parameters:
      maxMessageBytes - The endpoint's configured maximum message payload length
      Returns:
      A fresh extension handler, or a sharable handler
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • newWebSocketClientCompressionHandler

      default io.netty.handler.codec.http.websocketx.extensions.WebSocketClientExtensionHandler newWebSocketClientCompressionHandler(int maxMessageBytes)
      Creates a client handler that negotiates WebSocket compression extensions. The default retains Netty's compression settings and allocation policy and returns one sharable instance. Overrides may enforce the endpoint's payload limit on decompressed messages.
      Parameters:
      maxMessageBytes - The endpoint's configured maximum message payload length
      Returns:
      A fresh extension handler, or a sharable handler
      Since:
      5.3.0
